text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While out with Espoir City,
we saw a lone child wandering about.
Could this possibly be—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
What's with you, twerp? You on your own?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
From the looks of it, no parents around either...
Did it get separated from its pack?
choice_data_list: Then let's go to the lost-and-found center and make an announcement—

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!!
Th-The lost and found center!? An announcement!?

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text:
I'm not lost, okay!
I have somewhere I gotta go right now!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!?
What do you mean 'a place to go'? You're completely lost, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text: "L-Like I said! I'm not lost!! ...And I don't need no lost child center or announcements!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh!? Ahhh~!?
Ahhh...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...A-Aaah, geez...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Fine, whatever! If you're not lost, go wherever you want! Do whatever you please!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Even so.
We're sticking with you!!
What we do is our own business, right? Right?

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text:
??
...I-Is that so. Fine, do whatever you want!

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text: Alright, um... first, let's go over there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Espoir City has an idea.
Let's follow her plan for now.

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text: It's gotta be somewhere around here...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Huh.
You into women's fashion or somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text:
N-No! This is just a path along the way!
I'm actually going over there!

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text: Umm, let's see............

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Easy Home Budgeting, Tonight's Dinner...
Haha! Hey kiddo, what are you doing looking at shelves like this?"

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text:
I-It wasn't here!
Onto the next store...!

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text: I-If it's here...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey.
Are you almost done? With this shopping of yours, that is.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Alright! It's our turn to shop next!
The store we wanna hit up is, like――

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "The shop you were at first," that's it!!

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text: !? ...Th-The shop I used to be at?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
First off, which shop did you even just come out of?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, I can't stop thinking about it!
It must be such a fun shop!

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text:
... ......Y-Yeah.
...Um... If I recall...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Ha.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
It's 'cause I panicked and ran all over the place...
That's why 'they can't find me.'

text_block_list.name: Child's Mother
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you so much~!
Trainers and Umamusume of Tracen Academy!
Come on, Tecchan, say thank you too!

text_block_list.name: Lost Child
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. ...Th-thank... you.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ha. What an ungrateful squirt!
You could show a whole lot more gratitude, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—Center position, the broadcast, and all that.
It didn't turn into a big deal, right?
Saved a certain someone from worrying, didn't I~?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—Next time, don't be so stubborn, alright?
Someone who's truly strong has room to breathe!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, good grief.
What an annoying brat.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? What's the matter, huh?
Struck speechless by my sheer charisma?
choice_data_list: I should've recorded that line from earlier.
I hope they can just be honest with themselves.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh?! You're making too big a deal out of it. I told you, I didn't do anything special!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I mean, come on. If it's something minor like that, leave it to me and it's pretty much sorted!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Heh. That kiddo will be just fine!
Time to graduate from being stubborn!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? ...Aah!?
Who're you callin' a twerp, huh!?
